title: Geography Relationship Engine

scope_clarification.geography_pairs_note: Neither Mandal-AC, PC-District, nor any other geography pair is an independent W015 scope item. Specific administrative/electoral relationship pairs are in scope ONLY when required to implement and reconcile one of the seven W015 master relationship semantics.
scope_clarification.traceability_rule: Every proposed element must answer: 'What exact master relationship cannot be correctly implemented or reconciled without this element?' If no exact answer exists: CLASSIFIED D / DEFERRED.

items_removed_from_w015_scope: Standalone 'relational adjacency' capability (not one of the 7 master relationship types)
Quantitative 'overlap_percentage' calculation / weighting (classified as Category D / Deferred; discrete full/partial containment is sufficient)
Standalone PC ↔ District cross-tree relationship catalogue (classified as Category D / Deferred; not an independent master requirement)
Product hierarchy traversal capabilities / dedicated customer-facing APIs (AC -> Mandal -> GP -> Booth) (classified as Category D / Deferred)
Mandatory 'Telangana Pilot' scope mandate (bounded sample is a verification technique, not a master requirement)
Mandatory new backend API routes or service filenames (labeled candidate implementation mechanism — conditional only)
Redundant delimitation_constituency_mapping table (geography_entity_lineage from W014 satisfies old-to-new transitions)
Mobile client modifications / screen rewrites (W015 owner is DATA + BE)
Spatial inference, PostGIS geometry operations, GPS geocoding, PIN mapping (strictly quarantined to W016)
Broad automated data-quality anomaly detection engine (strictly quarantined to W017)

category_A_directly_mandated: old-to-new mapping across statutory and delimitation reorganizations
reconciliation test proving known geography relationships reconcile correctly
category_B_necessary_implementation_mech: Dual-table anchor reference model (relationships link stable anchor UUIDs/codes, not ephemeral version rows)

Temporal validity intervals [valid_from, valid_to) and PostgreSQL GiST exclusion: Category B ONLY where demonstrated that a relationship changes over time with coexisting historical records (e.g. constituency_district_timeline); not automatically required for static relationships
Canonical use of geography_entity_lineage (W014) to satisfy predecessor, successor, and old-to-new transitions without duplicate tables
Inherited W012 dataset_version registration and UNVERIFIED data status enforcement
Inherited W014 scenario isolation (WHERE NOT is_scenario)

Row Level Security (RLS) security policies: Inherited project-wide mandatory constraint; Category B only where required to safely implement newly authorized W015 relationship storage (zero security redesign)

Candidate backend relationship traversal queries: Candidate implementation mechanism — conditional. Category B only if repository inspection demonstrates backend code is required to implement or verify a master relationship; direct SQL query is sufficient where no backend behavior is required
category_C_existing_defects_to_fix: DEF-15-01: mandals table (Migration 022) has denormalized text 'district' column lacking FK to public.districts(id)
DEF-15-02: mandal_constituency_map table (Migration 022) uses legacy text ID instead of internal_id UUID
category_D_out_of_w015_deferred: Standalone PC ↔ District cross-tree relationship catalogue
Product hierarchy traversal APIs / endpoints (AC -> Mandal -> GP -> Booth)
Mobile client changes, mobile API migration, offline seed migration, UI screens
Spatial inference, PostGIS geometry calculations, ST_Contains, ST_Intersects (quarantined to W016)
GPS coordinate reverse geocoding, PIN code lookup, address matching (quarantined to W016)
Broad automated data-quality anomaly detection engine (quarantined to W017)
